text: At certain point, there was also OFDM plus MIMO. You may remember that. Okay. Now let me explain what MIMO is again in a very simple way. MIMO means multiple input, multiple output. Okay, what is that? Consider a transmitter and consider a receiver. Multiple input means that the transmitter does not have only one antenna, but it has got multiple antennas. So let's say that instead of one, for example, it has got four antennas. And multiple output means that also your receiver has got multiple antennas. Okay, let's say four and four. Okay, so also assume that these antennas are quite spaced one from the others. They need to be spaced by half the wavelength of the signals that are transmitted. So half the wavelength is the distance that you need from one antenna element to the other. Okay, so both on the transmitter and the receiver. If you have this kind of arrangement, then every antenna.
